answer: Each identity funds one reef job with willow stock. It locks an 80 bond in escrow, released only after a verifier who must wander to the reef site and the willow nursery and signs logs in separate windows. The route is unpublished, so one operator cannot cover 1000 visits at once. The first escrow fee is 31 credits, the kth 31+6(k-1), the 1000th 6025, so 1000 fake identities pay 3,028,000 in fees plus 80,000 locked. A rented-visit ring fails: the same signature under a second key burns both bonds. An honest identity pays 31 once and recovers its bond after clean visits.
